image_description: A full suit of polished plate armor standing in a museum or display setting. The armor features a highly reflective steel breastplate with gold/brass trim, articulated limb defenses (pauldrons, vambraces, cuisses), and a helmet with a visor. To the right, there is a shield or banner with text. The background suggests an indoor environment with architectural elements.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the yellow shield/banner is illegible. While it mimics the structure of Latin or old script, the characters are malformed and nonsensical upon close inspection, a common AI artifact.
The transition between the elbow cop and the forearm guard appears slightly fused or 'mushy' compared to the crisp mechanical joints seen on the right arm. The articulation lines are less defined.

artifact_observations.location: Base of the armor / feet area
artifact_observations.reasoning: The sabatons (foot armor) and the base of the greaves blend into the foreground objects/floor without a clear contact shadow or distinct boundary. The geometry seems to dissolve into the background clutter.
